content: system_message User Input: I want to create a toy car model. Create a box with dimensions 200x100x100(X,Y,Z) as the body. The windshield can be created by subtracting a 50x100x50 block from an upper edge of the box. Add four wheels with a radius of 25 and a thickness of 10: Place two at (25,0,0) and (175,0,0) facing in the Y-Axis (0,1,0), and two at (25,100,0) and (175,100,0) facing in the negative Y-Axis (0,-1,0). | Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once

content.text: I'll help you create a toy car model. Let me start by executing the first function call to create the main body of the car.

content.content: successfully created block object. Call now the next function!

content.text: Now I'll create the windshield by subtracting a block from the upper edge of the car body. Based on the description, I'll place this at the front upper edge.

content.content: successfully created block object. Call now the next function!

content.text: Now I'll add the four wheels. I'll create all four wheels in one function call. The wheels at Y=0 face in the positive Y direction (0,1,0), and the wheels at Y=100 face in the negative Y direction (0,-1,0).

content.content: successfully created cylinder object. Call now the next function!

content.text: Now that all the geometry has been created, I'll call the finished function.
